whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Place of the first time. In whatever library you wish to, imagine coming upon an item in the section named Antiquities. Imagine there a book that reads and from within about a time machine. Not dialogic time, but time. Not an electromechanical time machine, but made of stone in a place a long time ago. When time became real, question. Some say in 10,500 BC upon a plain above the Milky Way. And some claim it was near the Nile. When the earth was in the middle of the sky, it was near the Nile. When the earth, pyramids, and sphinx gazing east precisely reflected the heavens above. As above, so below. Some say that this was the place where and when man-womankind first conceived of a duality, theirs. A place out there. A place right here. Aligned in time. Which could be locked. And known as time and space. Machine of stone upon a plain upon a time depicted here. Question. A place in time aligned precisely. When and why. The knowledge of which escapes us now. Beyond space there is a time. Millennium footprint. Which. This. 13.
